caseName: Paveletz v. United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit
caseNameFull: Paveletz v. United States Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit

opinions.text: C. A. 3d Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed informa pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until December 27,1999, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
